name: Ostra
fantasy: The lamplighter who floats. Pulls the fight to her, then lets it fall in.
silhouette: the hovering lantern and the long trailing hem

card.loop: Damage fills Swell. Swollen, everything you cast is bigger and quicker. Seed, Fan, Trade, then pop it.
card.dash: Lob a lantern and trade places with whatever stands where it lands.
card.passive: Hits fill Swell, ten times faster on hunters. A knock heals you.
card.rmb: Fire a cluster of shards: the first foe is stunned, longer the further it flew.
card.e: Plant a seed that swells for up to 5s. Press again to pop it: bigger and harder the longer it grew.

weapons.tether_lantern: Slow drifting orbs. Pause 1.4s and the next one is Settled: harder, faster, and it slows.

passive.name: Swell
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Swell (ten times as fast against hunters). Full Swell makes you Swollen for 7s: your seed grows larger and faster, Trade lands sooner, your snap hits 40% harder. A knock heals you 20% of your health.

dash.name: Lantern Trade
dash.desc: Lob a lantern up to 12m at your aim. After 1s you are there, and any foe standing in the spot is sent to where you were, slowed 40% for 3s. Over the abyss you land on the last solid ground. Swollen: 0.72s.

variants.tap: Three shards in a tight fan, 12m. The middle one stuns the first foe it hits, from 0.3s up to 1s the further it flew. Swollen: +40% damage.

e.name: Brimseed
e.desc: Plant a seed up to 9m away (on ground, short of walls). It swells for 5s up to 3m wide, then pops by itself; press E again to pop it sooner. Damage 12 up to 3.5 times that by how long it grew, and everyone it catches is Grounded for 1s. Swollen: larger and quicker.

rank3.dash: allies close to where you land get a shield
rank3.kin: the pop pulls everything inside 1.3x its radius to the middle first, and the seed burns foes inside while it grows

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 11s -> 8.8s; the pop pulls foes in first and the growing seed burns.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; allies near your landing get a 20 shield for 3s.

tells.half: a ring of teal motes closes around her
tells.full: the lantern burns white and the hem lifts
tells.dash_spent: a pale ripple where she stood
